meta.philosophy: Four separate concepts. Not a return predictor and not a model-scoring exercise. Built to help a long-term investor decide how aggressively to deploy cash today.
meta.inherited: v6 opportunity framework, nonlinear VIX knots, drawdown bonuses, detector and analogues; v5 PIT macro; v4 price frames

hero.reason: Fear is somewhat elevated. Valuation remains bubble-like. Conditions are better than normal, but not a rare panic.

regime.rule: Each input votes BULL/CORRECTION/BEAR/PANIC from pre-registered bands. Modal vote wins; ties break toward the more severe regime. Confidence = modal votes / 5.

vix.definition: CBOE Volatility Index (30-day implied volatility on S&P 500).
vix.reason: Extreme fear historically accompanies major buying opportunities; the curve rewards extremes disproportionately.
vix.direction: Higher VIX = more fear = higher opportunity score.

drawdown.definition: Percentage decline of price from its all-time high.
drawdown.reason: Deeper drawdowns improve entry location and create room for recovery.

above_200dma.definition: Share of the 10-ETF universe trading above its 200-day moving average.
above_200dma.reason: Few names above trend marks broad capitulation rather than a narrow selloff.
above_200dma.direction: Fewer stocks above 200DMA = higher opportunity score.

below_200dma.definition: How far the index sits below its 200-day moving average.
below_200dma.reason: Price location versus trend captures how washed out the market is.
below_200dma.direction: Further below trend = higher opportunity score.

putcall.definition: Put/Call fear proxy from the VIX term structure (VIX9D/VIX - 1).
putcall.reason: 9-day vol above 30-day vol signals urgent demand for protection.
putcall.direction: Higher term-structure inversion = higher opportunity score.

mcclellan.definition: Breadth impulse proxy: RSP/SPY 19-day EMA minus 39-day EMA (inverted).
mcclellan.reason: Squared percentile so only genuine breadth extremes contribute.
mcclellan.direction: More negative breadth impulse = higher opportunity score.

fear_greed.source: constructed seven-component PIT series; display only, zero weight

disclosures: Four concepts are reported separately; no single score is claimed to explain everything.
Knots, bands and weights are pre-registered and disclosed; none were fitted to returns.
Credit Stress is independent; HY OAS has ~3y history and falls back to HYG/LQD with disclosure.
TED spread is a disclosed proxy (3M bill + curve inversion); literal LIBOR TED ended in 2021.
Market Internals are a separate diagnostic and are not added into the Buying Score.
Opportunity-cost scenarios hold other conditions constant and are descriptive, not a forecast.
Every score ships with contributions, top positives/negatives, sensitivity and a manual audit trail.
